options.label: The Modern Engineering Logbook
options.thesis: Clean, structured linear hierarchy designed for seamless transitions between project showcase cards and deep markdown reading.
options.viewport: Modern hero with portfolio intro and metrics, featured project cards with live links, and an organized markdown article feed.
options.risk: Familiar and dependable; prioritizes high usability, scanability, and content clarity over eccentric flourishes.

options.label: The Minimalist Studio Monograph
options.thesis: Generous whitespace, refined Swiss typography, and quiet monochrome precision inspired by modern design engineering (Linear, Vercel).
options.viewport: Understated hero with large editorial typography, borderless project cards with hover illumination, and an uninterrupted prose column.
options.risk: Extremely clean and understated; relies on typographic craft rather than bold ornament.

options.label: The Developer Tech Stack Ledger
options.thesis: Purpose-built for showcasing code repositories, live project links, and in-depth documentation with monospaced metadata callouts.
options.viewport: Interactive tech stack matrix hero, followed by rich markdown documentation views with syntax-highlighted code and table of contents.
options.risk: Deeply developer-focused; emphasizes technical utility, git ergonomics, and code snippet presentation.

canonCard.label: The Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: The classic modern developer portfolio and blog (Lee Robinson, Astro Paper, Next.js templates) executed at peak craft.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline, subtitle, hero image, and 2-column article card grid.
canonCard.risk: Familiar to every developer; effective and clean, but follows the established template formula.
